blurb: Pier 39 Marina offers guest docking from March to mid October with advanced reservations required at least 24 hours in advance. They prioritize long-term tenants but accommodate the general public for guest docking. The marina also offers rental slips and subleases for long-term leaseholders with specific requirements and restrictions.
extraNote: No same day guest docking requests accepted · Guest dock closed 20 August to 1 October for dredging · Liveaboard permit waitlist is closed · Liveaboard permits are non-transferrable and assigned to individuals · March to mid October
